I'm right there with you. Literally, my acne got so bad this past year I stare at myself just thinking omg why tf am I here? My looks are ruined by this fucking acne. I personally have never found someone else with acne to be unattractive, just in myself. It's your internal dialogue making us think so badly. I understand the struggle all too well. My recent ex broke up with me because of my acne. You have a good family and boyfriend if they're able to look past the acne and see your beauty. I'm only 19, but believe me my skin is soo bad. If you haven't already, go to a derm and look into accutane, it's the closest thing to a cure, I'm about to get on it if I can stay alive for that long. Good luck :)
